patch.value: Barnaby Thorne lives next door to the school garden and has won the fair's giant pumpkin prize six years running. This year the children's Bertha grew bigger than his Goliath. On Friday afternoon he secretly climbed over the fence to measure her, then spent the evening at the fair's growers' barbecue across town.
Barnaby Thorne lives next door to the school garden.

value: He has won the fair's giant pumpkin prize six years running. The blue ribbons hang on his shed.
He feeds Goliath a secret 'seaweed tea' and says good morning to him every day.
Goliath is a bit smaller than Bertha was, which has made him grumpy all week.
His ginger cat, Marmalade, likes to sleep in his wheelbarrow.
He has lived next to the school for forty years and grumbles about footballs flying over his fence.
Secretly he thinks the children did a fine job with Bertha, though he would never say so.
He says the growers' barbecue has the best sausages in the county.
